newsitem.title: USA: New England Business Q2 shr $0.43 vs $0.26.
newsitem.headline: New England Business Q2 shr $0.43 vs $0.26.

text.p: Three Months Ended Six Months Ended

NOTE: Net income for the second quarter ended December 28, 1996, included an aftertax charge of $588 or $0.04 per share related to the discontinuation of the Kinko's retail initiative along with other cost actions, and an aftertax benefit of $844 or $0.06 per share relating to the curtailment of the Company's defined benefit pension plan.
Net income for the second quarter ended December 31, 1995 included $1,149 or $0.08 per share of aftertax charges and expenses relating to the implementation of a cost reduction program.

(b) Net income for the six months ended December 28, 1996 included an aftertax charge of $3,421 or $0.25 per share related to the discontinuation of the Kinko's retail initiative along with other cost actions, and an aftertax benefit of $588 or $0.06 per share relating to the curtailment of the Company's defined benefit pension plan. Net income for the six months ended December 31, 1995 included $6,221 or $0.42 per share of aftertax charges and expenses relating to the implementation of a cost reduction program.
